revivals.rule:
For each pair, film A is older than film B. Decide how B relates to A's story:
- "remake": B remakes A (same story; same title or an acknowledged remake).
- "adaptation": A and B adapt the same source (the same novel, story, play or legend about the same named figure), though neither remakes the other.
- "retelling": B clearly retells A's particular story under another title (same premise, same roles and arc), without being a remake or adaptation of the same source.
- "sequel": B continues A's story or franchise (sequel, prequel, or a continuation that calls itself a remake or reboot of the series' later entries).
- "unrelated": B only shares a theme, setting, monster type or genre with A.
Use the titles, years and synopses, and your own knowledge of the films.
